caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device consisting of a rectangular box base and a cylindrical component mounted horizontally on top. The cylinder has a slot with a metallic plate or guard secured by screws, exposing a dark, textured area suggesting internal gears or brushes. Attached to the left side of the device is a metal crank handle with a brown wooden grip. The main body of the machine has brownish and grey hues, with shading used to indicate metallic and wooden textures. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details. The artist’s name, “JESSIE M. YOUNGS,” appears at the bottom left corner.
title: Coffee Roaster
